Outcome_variable.evidence_source: Two clusters with generalized low SWB were found: One with very high Negative Affect (Cluster 3) and one with very low Global Life Satisfaction (Cluster 4). The women in Cluster 3 not only reported low Global Life-Satisfaction and Positive Affect and high Negative Affect. Two clusters being normal in Global Life-Satisfaction but with deviant means in affect were found: Cluster 2, characterized by both Positive and Negative Affect being above average and Cluster 5, characterized by low Positive Affect. The findings indicate an alternative way of representing the relationship structure among the three general SWB components
